steps: This flow shows M C P. Your code lists two servers: fs over standard input and output, and crm over H T T P. The Agent S D K acts as the client, one protocol with no per-tool glue.
First, the client spawns fs as a local subprocess and asks for its tool list over J S O N R P C. It discovers read file, and fs can also offer resources and prompts.
Next, it connects to the remote crm server over H T T P and discovers its lookup customer tool. Both servers are now connected.
Now tool names become M C P, server, tool. The client sends Claude the prompt and the two tools, and allowed tools decides which ones Claude may use.
Claude reads look up customer C seventy-seven, and returns a tool use with the full name, the crm server's lookup customer tool, and the id C seventy-seven.
The client routes it to crm as a tools call over H T T P, and crm returns the record: Globex, on the gold tier.
Finally, the record returns as a tool result, and Claude answers in one turn that C seventy-seven is Globex. The answer is grounded in real data.
